mechanism: Both agents cause vasodilation and reduce blood pressure through different mechanisms (ARB vs neprilysin inhibition), increasing risk of hypotension and hyperkalemia; sacubitril/valsartan is a fixed combination that should not be used with additional ARBs.
action: Do not combine telmisartan with sacubitril; if ARNI therapy is indicated, discontinue telmisartan and use sacubitril/valsartan combination alone with close monitoring of potassium and renal function.
